title: Console permission journeys: temporary delegation, CSV member imports, and audit-aware edit flow
creator: Aisha Moreno
description: Design ticket for three linked Console flows in RBAC v2: 1) temporary delegation (time-limited role grants) with safety guardrails and audit metadata; 2) CSV-driven bulk member assignment with preview/validation and SAML group mapping hints; 3) audit-aware role edit flow that surfaces recent changes, simulated impact, and reversible diffs. Goal: reduce admin friction for large tenants while preventing accidental privilege escalation and ensuring clear audit trails.
acceptance_criteria: Temporary delegation UX enables granting time-bounded role to a member or group with start/end and automatic revocation recorded in audit log
CSV bulk import shows a preview table with row-level validation, SAML group suggestion column, and a dry-run mode that outputs potential permission changes
Role edit screen displays a compact chronological change summary, a simulated permission impact viewer (which routes to example resources), and a one-click rollback for last change
All flows include inline microcopy calling out admin-only actions, required SSO mappings, and link to 'simulate impact' modal
Design artifacts (Figma) and interaction specs are linked and reviewed by Security and Product; handoff tokens included for engineering
comments: 2025-02-11 - Aisha Moreno: Initial wireframes attached. Focused on reducing modal depth for temp grants; prefer an inline timeline control over free text expiry.
2025-02-12 - Security review (Priya Patel): Requires explicit admin confirmation for delegation to groups that are SAML-synced; add a note about audit retention settings.
2025-02-13 - PM feedback (Omar Ruiz): CSV import must support email, user ID, and SAML group column. Add an opt-in dry-run that outputs changes as downloadable JSON.
2025-02-14 - Eng sync (Luca Chen): Backend needs an endpoint for dry-run that returns per-row errors. We'll expose a preview API and a single 'apply' call to reduce race conditions.
2025-02-17 - Design review (Elena K.): Adjusted simulated impact modal to show 3 example resource types and probability-of-affect estimate rather than full resource listing.
2025-02-18 - Accessibility review (Marcus Li): Ensure CSV preview table supports keyboard row expansion and ARIA labels for status icons.
notes: Trade-offs: Showing full resource-level permission impact is high risk for performance; we will use representative samples and allow admins to request a deeper audit job.
Decision: Temporary delegation defaults to two-week expiry with presets (1d, 7d, 14d, 30d). Super-admins can extend with justification required in audit note.
Follow-ups: Add telemetry events for CSV import failures, temp grant expirations, and manual revocations so Customer Success can monitor tenant behavior.
Handoff: Provide engineering with Figma prototype, interaction spec, and API contract examples in Confluence page before sprint start.
